title: Craft Blend 3-Mix Trio #26 (IndianMughal+NigerianAdire+YorubaAdireEleko / KoreanNajeon+KoreanEunipsa+PeruvianNazca / FinnishIittala+SpanishTalaveraReina+MoroccanZellige)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Indian woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, bold and confident, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real living eyes. Long square nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Indian Mughal miniature gold-work (a deep midnight-blue ground with fine gold linework and medallions, wide gold-and-crimson bands, dense jewel-toned scrollwork) dominates one zone. Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye (a deep indigo-blue ground with bold white resist-dyed motifs, wide white bands, dense spiral resist motifs) dominates the second zone. Yoruba adire eleko pattern (a deep indigo ground with bold cream resist-painted geometric motifs, wide cream bands, dense geometric bird motifs) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto studded boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Vietnamese woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, soft porcelain skin, delicate rose-pink eyeshadow, glossy soft-coral lips, cheerful, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes. Long round nails, glossy finish.

Center woman's physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer (glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines, wide mother-of-pearl bands, dense dense scrollwork) dominates one zone. Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework, wide bold silver bands, dense lattice fills) dominates the second zone. Peruvian Nazca painted pattern (a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures, wide gold bands, dense stepped geometric borders) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: reclining on her side, propped on one elbow.

Center woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform wedges, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Italian woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a defined edge, a smouldering, confident expression, cheerful, bright golden-blonde hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glittery finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework (a deep indigo ground with bold cream concentric ripple-line motifs, wide cream bands, dense concentric ripple linework) dominates one zone. Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions, wide cobalt bands, dense floral medallion border) dominates the second zone. Moroccan zellige tile mosaic (a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs, wide gold bands, dense interlocking star-and-cross motifs) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground.

Right woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform buckled boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
